transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: hello there

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — how is your eye doing since your surgery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Fine, thanks.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Glad to hear that. Are your eyes red?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I haven't noticed any eye redness.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Are your eyes painful?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I don't have any eye pain.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Has your vision improved as you expected since the surgery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I've noticed some mild blurry vision since the surgery, and I'm a bit concerned about it. Could you provide some guidance on that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Thanks for letting me know. I’ve made a note of the concern, and someone will review it if needed.

Has the blurry vision been affecting distance, close-up, or both?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: It's mostly mild blurry vision affecting distance.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Are you able to see clearly at a distance, such as watching TV?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I can see, but the mild blurry vision makes it a bit difficult to see clearly at a distance, like watching TV.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Is the blurry vision also affecting close up, while reading?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, the blurry vision hasn't been affecting my close-up vision, like while reading.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. When did you first notice the blurriness?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I first noticed the mild blurry vision shortly after the surgery.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Has the blurriness been getting better, worse, or staying about the same?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: The mild blurry vision has been staying about the same since I first noticed it.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Would you say the vision is slightly hazy, or completely blurred? Also, is the blurriness only when you are wearing your old glasses?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: The vision is slightly hazy, but not completely blurred. I haven't noticed any difference with or without my old glasses.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you noticed any floaters since the surgery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I haven't noticed any floaters since the surgery.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you noticed any flashing lights since the surgery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I haven't noticed any flashing lights since the surgery.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Thanks. Just to summarize: after surgery, your eye has been doing fine overall. There’s no eye redness or eye pain. You’ve noticed mild blurry vision since shortly after the surgery, mainly affecting distance vision like watching TV, not close-up reading. It’s slightly hazy, has stayed about the same, and doesn’t seem related to wearing your old glasses. No floaters and no flashing lights.

Is that summary correct?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, that's correct.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you.

verdict.label: pass
